occurrences.exact_quote:
| Figure | Primary function | Distinction to preserve |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **Aion** | Eternity, age, encompassing temporal regime | Duration or totality, not necessarily sequential time |
| **Chronos** | Time, succession, duration | Distinguished from the Titan Cronus |
| **Cronus / Kronos** | Titan genealogy, sovereignty, succession | Later associations with time must retain their own source lineage |
| **Kairos** | Critical or opportune moment | Conditions for an event, not elapsed duration |
| **Horos** | Boundary, limit, demarcation | Determines where one regime ends and another begins |
| **Ananke** | Necessity, constraint | What must happen, rather than when it happens |
